installCommand: bash -lc 'if [ -f source/web-assets/frontend/package.json ]; then npm --prefix source/web-assets/frontend install --legacy-peer-deps --include=dev; else npm install --legacy-peer-deps --include=dev; fi'
buildCommand: bash -lc 'if [ -f source/web-assets/frontend/package.json ]; then npm --prefix source/web-assets/frontend run build && rm -rf build && cp -R source/web-assets/frontend/build ./build; else npm run build; fi'
